_about: Reference: the PERMIT DISPATCHER as it runs on the original install - a browser_mod popup opened by a tile tap_action (this object). Needs HACS cards custom:button-card, custom:stack-in-card, card-mod and the browser_mod integration; the card_mod Jinja blocks marked skin-* read input_select.card_skin (that install's skin switcher) - delete those blocks or define the helper. The core-cards version in examples/dashboard_permit_dispatcher.yaml does the same without any of this.
